_doc: Rules that decide which team names count as the same organization in LoL Grid (applied by npm run build-players).
Principle: one organization = one team, across sponsor renames and sister rosters (SKT T1 K/S → T1, Gamers2 → G2, KSV → Gen.G).
A sold league slot is a different organization (Samsung Galaxy ≠ KSV/Gen.G, OpTic Gaming ≠ Immortals).
merge: organization name (the label shown in the game) → other names that belong to it.
split: names whose Leaguepedia 'RenamedTo' link must NOT be followed (the name stays its own team).
labels: display name for an organization whose Leaguepedia page title is awkward or outdated (the id stays derived from the page title).
logos: Leaguepedia file name of the logo, when the Teams table has none or an outdated one.
Leaguepedia renames not listed here are followed automatically (e.g. Gamers2 → G2 Esports, KSV eSports → Gen.G).
